title: SupermarketAdapterRegistry
description: Declared UK supermarket adapter registry with supported capabilities and unsupported reasons

asda.name: Asda
asda.reason: unsupported: Server returns client-side SPA shell without embedded product data — requires browser execution

iceland.name: Iceland
iceland.reason: unsupported: Server returns client-side PWA shell with unpopulated productsById — search delegated to client-side Algolia

aldi.name: Aldi
aldi.reason: unsupported: No UK online grocery platform — estimated data only (Click & Collect discontinued)

lidl.name: Lidl
lidl.reason: unsupported: No UK online grocery platform — in-store shopping only (estimated data only)
